title: LP T0 -- Foundation: tokens, primitives, layer scale, guard tests, before gallery
description: Brief: docs/agent-work/2026-11-12-layout-primitives/BRIEF.md, then task T0 of docs/agent-work/2026-11-12-layout-primitives/PLAN.md. Shared files are edited by owned selector/region only and registered on no task.

review.note: APPROVE. Full: docs/agent-work/2026-11-12-layout-primitives/REVIEW-1.md. URGENT for workers: (1) CSS order is the reverse of design-system.md: main.tsx:3 imports App before styles.css/layout.css, so nearly every component CSS loads BEFORE layout.css (confirmed in the dist bundle: .writer>.format-bar at 1663, .dropdown-menu at 19744 < :root at 54324). layout.css therefore WINS single-class ties against component CSS and styles.css. Exceptions that load after it: prose-issues.css (T3), icon-magnify, appearance-settings, side-ruler. Delete old declarations (a leftover block padding makes rows taller); two-class rules (.writer > .format-bar, .writer .toolbar-popover) still beat primitives; single-class overrides of a primitive lose silently. Fix the design-system.md sentence. (2) layout.css:108-112 .panel --row-height:28 inherits into in-place dropdown menus (Dropdown.tsx:188, absolute) inside Page setup's panel, giving 28px menu rows (DoD 4). Proposed amendment to The system: add '--row-height: var(--control-height);' to .menu. (2b) .gap-N does nothing on .bar/.row (hard-coded gap space-2), so bar + divider = 16px per side, not 8. T3 overrides with .writer > .format-bar{gap:0}; others: use a .cluster.gap-N child. Low: chevron 14px sits 1px inside .flush-end edge (T2 column check at tolerance; compare slot boxes); ink() ignores input/select/checkbox (add a border-box fallback); budget: substring doc-selector skip and new-file loophole; error banner 30->40 now paints over the citation card (39).
